method: Pretrained ImageNet ResNet-50 top-1/top-5 classification on 100 deterministic sampled classes per generator, compared with one reserved same-class real image per class.
class_index_field: Filename component 4 (zero-based after generator, 1000, 200), range 000-999; each value has six images in official val/ai.
interpretation: Supports the filename class mapping as a sample-level check; generated-image semantic fidelity is lower than real-image classification. It is not a per-image ground-truth audit.
